What Is AI SEO?

A Note Before We Begin

I'm Sufian Mustafa, founder of Do It With AI Tools. I wrote this introduction to share the story behind the article.

The AI SEO Framework: AEO, GEO, and AI-Assisted SEO Explained

AI SEO can be structured into three interconnected layers:

  • AEO (Answer Engine Optimization) — focuses on direct answers within search results.
  • GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) — focuses on generative AI systems outside traditional search.
  • AI-Assisted SEO — focuses on using AI tools to improve traditional SEO workflows.

What Is AEO (Answer Engine Optimization) and Why It Matters for AI SEO

AEO is the practice of structuring and optimizing content to directly answer specific questions.

What Is GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) and How Does It Differ from AEO

GEO focuses on ensuring your content is discovered, understood, cited, and referenced by standalone AI engines.

AI-Assisted SEO: Using Artificial Intelligence to Power Your Traditional SEO Workflow

AI-Assisted SEO uses generative AI tools to enhance traditional SEO workflows.
